note: Rotating learning topics, used by scheduled cycles in order. Keep them different from benchmark.json so lab comparisons stay held-out.

topics.question: How can a neighborhood reduce food waste by 30 percent in six months? Propose a plan and how to measure it.
Why do some habits stick while others fade? Suggest an experiment to compare two habit-building methods.
A school wants students to read more for pleasure. What approaches could work and how would they know?
How could a small clinic reduce missed appointments without spending much money?
What makes a scientific claim trustworthy? Describe how to judge a surprising health claim you read online.
A city wants fewer traffic injuries near schools. What interventions are plausible and how should they be evaluated?
How should a team decide between two software designs when evidence is incomplete?
Why do rumors spread faster than corrections, and what could reduce the spread?
How can a household cut electricity use by 15 percent? Rank options by evidence and effort.
What is a good way to learn a new language in 100 days, and how would you measure progress?
How can an online community keep discussions respectful without heavy moderation?
A farmer has less water each year. Which adaptations are most promising and how can she test them cheaply?
What would a fair evaluation of a new teaching app look like?
How do sleep, exercise and study time interact for exam performance? What can and cannot be concluded from observation?
